_comment: Create the OAuth client in Google Cloud Console as application type 'iOS' — that is the type Google requires for macOS apps. Enter this app's bundle ID (com.victorlam.ContactSyncMate); leave App Store ID and Team ID blank. An iOS client is a public client and is issued NO secret, so leave clientSecret empty. PKCE is what protects the exchange. Then set CFBundleURLSchemes in Info.plist to the same reversed client ID used below.
